description: Change an application's display name. The slug is immutable — every other tool refers to the app by slug, so a rename breaks nothing. Use delete_app + create_app only if the slug itself must change. Returns the updated { id, orgId, name, slug, createdAt }.

app.description: Application slug or id, as returned by list_apps (e.g. "storefront").

name.description: The new display name, e.g. "Acme Storefront (EU)".

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: rename_app
